# CanWinBuddy

> AI study tool that turns any text, document, or image into validated quizzes and curriculum-aware worksheets, and exports to Blooket, Gimkit, Gimkit 2, and Kahoot.

CanWinBuddy uses AI to generate quiz questions and exam-style worksheets matched to subject, age, difficulty and curriculum, and validates every question against the original source material before saving. Users can play sets in-app or copy/export them in the exact format required by popular quiz platforms.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in to generate and manage quiz sets.
